learn.title: Per hundred
learn.body: Percent means per hundred. 25% means 25 out of 100, which is $\frac{25}{100}=\frac{1}{4}$, or $0.25$. A percent is just a fraction with denominator 100, so you already know how to work with it.

learn.title: Converting
learn.body: Percent to decimal: divide by 100, which moves the point two places left, so $35\%=0.35$. Decimal to percent: multiply by 100, so $0.07=7\%$. Fraction to percent: make the denominator 100. $\frac{3}{5}=\frac{60}{100}=60\%$.

learn.title: Percent of a number
learn.body: To find a percent of a number, turn the percent into a decimal and multiply. Half of 50 is 25, and $50\%=0.5$, so $0.5\times 50=25$ agrees. Easy ones: 50% is half, 25% is a quarter, 10% is one tenth.

learn.title: Find 35% of 80
learn.body: Write 35% as a decimal, then multiply.
To find 10% of a number, move the point one place left. 10% of 200 is 20. Then build up: 5% is half of that, 15% is 10% plus 5%.

questions.prompt: What is 25% as a fraction in simplest form?
Write $0.07$ as a percent. Give the number only.
Match each percent with its decimal.
questions.explanation: Divide by 100. A percent over 100 gives a decimal over 1.
